correctness.rationale: The source equations transform exactly to the mean/difference system. For every unequal interior fixed point the positive transmission rate and squared difference are explicit. Signs of an exactly calculated Jacobian give saddle versus sink. The determinant polynomial is negative for s<=1/4, and for 1/4<s<1/2 is positive iff epsilon>F(s). F has a unique global minimum (9+24sqrt(3))/61. A sum-of-squares identity proves trace<0 whenever determinant>0. Every epsilon above the minimum and below 1 has a feasible explicit stable pair at s=(3-sqrt(3))/4; epsilon at or below has no hyperbolic sink. Independent original vector-field and Jacobian rational-extension verifier evaluates 544 exact instances; exact witness epsilon=9/10, s=1/3, d²=2/27, lambda=9/2 has trace -1, determinant 6/25. Tests are corroborative only.

value.rationale: The initiating social-contagion article investigates disparity and numerically observed stable unequal spreading in communities. The exact minimum triangle homophily at which stable disparity is possible for some transmission rate is a naturally motivated global phase boundary; rigorous exclusion below and constructive attainment above distinguish stable segregation from mere nonsymmetric saddles. The algebraic boundary and rational witness provide an exact reproducible benchmark. It is not claimed to be a general theory of hypergraph epidemic dynamics.
